name: obsidian_open_in_ui
description: Open a file in the Obsidian app UI. By default fails when the path does not exist; the `failIfMissing` flag controls the open-or-create behavior. Opening an existing file needs read access; opening a missing one creates it, so that case needs write access to the path. A path with no exact match but a single case-insensitive match in its folder opens that file instead and reports the path as sent in `requestedPath`.

failIfMissing.description: When true (default), fails if the file does not exist. When false, allows Obsidian to create the file on open — which requires write access to the path and is rejected in read-only mode.

newLeaf.description: Open in a new leaf (split pane) instead of the active one.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the file to open.
